routeReason: Independent QA confirmed an existing delivery-entry gate gap, so the narrow correction follows the formal Fixer to QA route.
contextOmitted: Unrelated game mechanics, vehicle assets, historical reports, browser state, and upload payloads.
changes: Match opening and closing script tags case-insensitively, permit whitespace before a closing tag terminator, and keep exact source-body slices.
Check each matched opening tag for a case-insensitive src assignment with optional whitespace before equals; count uppercase scripts toward exactly two entries.
Keep all hash, ZIP, natural-stage, notice and child syntax checks intact; no large-body lazy regex or body case conversion.

coveredCases: An additional uppercase inline SCRIPT is rejected by the two-script count.
Mixed-case opening/closing tags preserve Chinese text, case, CRLF and final newlines exactly.
The original 23 contracts, including the 14 MiB localized payload and all existing integrity/natural gates, remain unchanged and pass.

syntaxBoundary.scope: A bounded scanner for this generated standalone HTML; not a general HTML parser.
syntaxBoundary.supported: Whitespace-separated attributes with src assignment, case-insensitive SCRIPT tags, closing tags with optional whitespace, and exact raw script-body slicing.
unsupported: Slash-separated or self-closing script start tags, slash-separated attributes, and valueless src are not covered by the entry predicate; this change does not establish rejection for those forms.
Opening tags with a quoted > value and attribute values containing src-like text are not parsed as full attribute tokens; they may be misclassified.
HTML comments, other raw-text elements, foreign-content contexts and malformed-markup recovery are not modeled.
syntaxBoundary.consequence: The passing gate verifies the generated package and named regressions. It must not be described as universally rejecting external scripts in arbitrary HTML.

remainingEvidenceGaps: Root must rerun the actual final delivery manifest using these final source bytes.
